proposal.title: Operational Foundations of Causal Memory
proposal.summary: This research cycle advances the synthesis of operational causal memory criteria by integrating thermodynamic bounds with coarse-grained state reconstruction. Evidence confirms that persistent physical states operate as memory only when they provide predictive sufficiency under specific coarse-graining limits, with maintenance costs modulated by nonequilibrium environmental coupling.
